name: Hako-inu
source:
Funny dog-like creature which is [url=/c1352]Nanase[/url]'s pet. [url=/c1346]Natsuki[/url] mainly uses it as a pillow during her work. Gender unknown. 

[spoiler]In Hinata's ending of the novel you could see it has a puppy.[/spoiler]
